candidates.exact_span: additional facility NPDES Application Form and DMRs
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether the cited application form and DMRs govern an additional facility, and which limits, discharge points, and reported measurements they cover, affects which enforceable numeric limits apply (A), which monitoring was required and evidenced (B), and how missing or no-result monitoring is classified when DMR evidence is expected (C).

The scope of what counts as included permit application information can change which proposed or permitted numeric discharge limits are treated as enforceable (A) and which monitoring schedules or conditional requirements are treated as applicable (B).

Critical conditions information often underlies derivation and applicability of numeric discharge limits and can trigger or qualify monitoring obligations; different interpretations of which critical conditions are incorporated could change applicable limits (A) and whether related monitoring was required (B).
